snippet.title: Factor72
snippet.description:
https://antonmakesgames.itch.io/factor72

Slide your cursor to multiply numbers to get 72. Get as much as possible in 3 minutes.  
Multiple game modes are available such as bigger grids or different playtime.   
Compete with friends by sharing seeds or compete with others with the daily seed.
Also available at https://factor72.fun
I'm very happy whenever I get a message, feel free to post your score in the comments!

By AntonMakesGames - 2024
🎼Trailer music by Nifflas - https://nifflas.itch.io/
